import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, concurrent.futures, re, time
live=json.load(open('/tmp/nm_live.json'))
def chat(k):
    body={"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ok"}],"max_tokens":5}
    r=urllib.request.Request('https://nomask.ai/api/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+k,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as resp: json.load(resp); return k,True
    except Exception: return k,False
ok=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(5) as ex:
    for k,s in ex.map(chat,list(live)):
        if s: ok.append(k)
emails={}
for f in ['nm_api_keys.txt','nm2_api.txt']:
    for l in open(f):
        if '|' in l and 'nmk_live_' in l:
            p=[x.strip() for x in l.split('|')]
            emails[p[1]]=p[0]
with open('nm_ready.txt','w') as f:
    f.write("# nomask — key TERUJI CHAT OK\n")
    f.write(f"# total {len(ok)} key | {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}\n")
    f.write("# format: email | api_key | model\n")
    for k in ok: f.write(f"{emails.get(k,'?')} | {k} | deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored\n")
print("nomask siap pakai:",len(ok))
EOF
